name: Small Covered Jar with Decoration of Stylized Lotus Arabesque
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；mid 16th-early 17th century；Enameled porcelain: porcelain with decoration painted in gold enamels a red enamel ground; with underglaze cobalt-blue mark reading "Chang Chun Yong Bao" within a double circle on the base, the mark and double circle arranged to simulate a Chinese coin.
